definitions.gloss: circuit board; printed circuit board; substrate
definitions.explanation: A flat board made of insulating material on which electronic components are mounted and connected by conductive pathways. Also refers more broadly to any base plate or substrate in manufacturing.

examples.japanese: {基板|きばん}を{交換|こうかん}する。
{基板|きばん}に{部品|ぶひん}をはんだ{付|づ}けする。
examples.english: To solder components onto a circuit board.

examples.japanese: {故障|こしょう}の{原因|げんいん}は{基板|きばん}の{損傷|そんしょう}だった。
examples.english: The cause of the malfunction was damage to the circuit board.

notes:
{基板|きばん} refers to a physical board or substrate, most commonly a circuit board in electronics.

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with {基盤|きばん} (foundation, basis), which is abstract. {基板|きばん} always refers to a physical board.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プリント{基板|きばん}: printed circuit board (PCB)
- {基板|きばん}{交換|こうかん}: board replacement
- {基板|きばん}{設計|せっけい}: board design
- {電子|でんし}{基板|きばん}: electronic circuit board

USAGE:
In arcade game culture, {基板|きばん} also refers to the game board hardware itself. This is a technical term most commonly encountered in electronics, manufacturing, and IT contexts.
